Turn on session persistence for pagination and filters

Avo has offered the :session persistence driver since 3.15.4, but the demo
never enabled it, so per-page picks on association tables and static filter
selections reset on every request and the feature looks absent to visitors.

Add Avo documentation context and skills loader

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a18709-425f-7211-8950-a571b75aa9eb

Keep media library files attached when inserted into an Action Text Trix field

Inserted files carried only a URL, so Action Text stored non-image files as missing attachables and the
Show page rendered them empty. The media library now passes the blob's sgid through.

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1699c-53a6-728f-a01f-76c7c2502558
Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul@avohq.io>

Return the model's attachment name from valid_attachment_name

The attachments controller sends that name to the record. Returning the reflection's name instead of the
request's keeps the request value out of send, which CodeQL flagged as code injection.

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1699c-53a6-728f-a01f-76c7c2502558
Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul@avohq.io>

Trix uploads work on the New form and Action Text keeps every file type

Trix blocked uploads until the record was saved and on plain columns without an
attachment_key, and Action Text stored non-image uploads without an sgid, so they
rendered as missing. Giving them an sgid made Action Text render the app's blob
partial with Avo's engine router, which can't build Active Storage URLs, so Avo
now renders Action Text with the host app's controller.

Refs #2715

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1699c-53a6-728f-a01f-76c7c2502558
Co-authored-by: Paul Bob <paul@avohq.io>

fix: keep tab frame state when going back after switching tabs

Switching tabs rewrites the URL with history.replace, which Turbo's view
does not track, so the page was cached under the old URL. Browser back then
missed the cache and refetched the page, resetting the tab's sort and page.

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a169a9-113c-76f8-b754-7dcccce8190f

fix: the required asterisk stays beside its label on a validation error

Rails' field_error_proc wraps an errored label in a block div.field_with_errors, which pushed
the asterisk onto its own line.
